result: Current TB diagnostics are severely limited. The mainstay sputum smear microscopy (dating to 1882) detects only about 50% of active TB cases, with even lower sensitivity in HIV-positive patients. Culture tests require 10-60 days due to slow bacterial growth. Neither method determines drug resistance, contributing to diagnostic delays that resulted in deaths of many XDR-TB patients in Tugela Ferry before diagnosis.
